h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Rohtak

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Rohtak

items.pText: Rohtak is one of Haryana's main education centres, with a large university, a medical institute and many schools, and it shares the weather of nearby Delhi. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment for campuses, residential sectors and parks in Rohtak. We manufacture it in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,120 km away, and bring it up by road.

Campus buyers often want a play area for staff families inside the residential block of a university or hospital. These sites tend to be large and open, with lawns and little shade. We look at where people walk, where the sun falls in the afternoon and how old the children are. Send us those details with photos, and we will return a layout drawing with the safe play area marked for your estate office.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Summer heat and winter cold in Rohtak

c: Haryana summers are harsh, and afternoons in May and June can make metal and dark plastic too hot to touch. Put slides and decks under a tree line or near a
, and choose lighter colours for surfaces children sit on. Where you can, turn the slide bed away from the afternoon sun.

Winters swing the other way, with cold mornings and thick fog. Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic handle both extremes without rusting. Rubber flooring under the equipment stays usable through both seasons. For adult fitness on the same campus, see our

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,120 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Do you supply universities and hospitals with staff housing?
items.a: Yes. We plan play areas for residential blocks on large campuses. You get a layout drawing and a quote that your estate or engineering office can review before approval.

items.q: How do we keep slides cool in summer?
items.a: Shade is the most reliable fix. Keep or plant trees, add a pergola or shade sail, and choose lighter colours for slide beds and seats. Avoid placing slides on the western edge of the site.

items.q: Do you deliver from Vasai to Rohtak?
items.a: Yes, by road. The equipment is installed by our team or a dealer in north India, using grouting or a self-standing base depending on your ground.
